name: Ryoujoku Ukeoinin Tsuboshi ~Shikumareta Sangeki~
original_name: 凌辱請負人 壺師 ～仕組まれた惨劇～
source:
Main character's occupation is guru. The the system of mail he receives requests. What unites them is the need to scold target humans. He can proceed with the requests growing more and more wild or move on to the next targets.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的职业是导师。他收到请求的邮件系统。让他们团结起来的是需要责骂目标人类。他可以继续处理越来越疯狂的请求，或者转向下一个目标。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
